rationale: B wins because its proof demands are sharper and closer to what a real reporter will ask before touching this. B's "What happens to the crew when the guac machine shows up" gets to total labor hours, pay, redeployment, and time-bound promises; A's "In Chipotle's test kitchens, one robot cut guacamole prep time in half" is a valid fact, but thin as a standalone angle. Both sets overreach on the two-robot thesis, but B wastes less space and gives the founder better tripwires before pitching.
gaps_in_A: "In Chipotle's test kitchens, one robot cut guacamole prep time in half" is a weak standalone story; without baseline minutes, sample size, and commercial-scale validation, it is supporting proof for another angle, not much of an angle itself.

"Digital Makeline's testing was disclosed alongside the Autocado rollout, making the two-system pattern visible for the first time" adds a "first time" claim the update does not give you. That's how a decent trade angle becomes a fact-check problem.
"company-wide automation thesis" is too grand for two disclosed systems, one of which is only being tested. Say kitchen-automation strategy, not thesis cosplay.
"the industry's usual pattern of automation reducing headcount over time" imports outside context without sourcing it. A labor reporter may know that context; this angle set still has to prove it.
gaps_in_B: "the first evidence that a major chain is automating a full assembly-line format" is an invented bigness claim. The update gives Autocado plus a Digital Makeline test, not an industry first or a full-line proof point.
"Other operators watching this decide their own capex from it" is speculation dressed as market consequence. Maybe true, but not in the supplied facts.
"Two robots, one bowl" is clever, but the angle risks overclaiming integration. The update does not say Autocado and Digital Makeline work together in the same restaurants or workflow.
"Next step: `newsjack-detector`" is tool-brained. Useful only if this is a reactive newsjack; for first-party Chipotle news, the immediate next step is closing proof gaps and checking prior coverage.
